==Notes==
* Applied to all party members after capturing the [[North Morale Shrine]] and [[South Morale Shrine]] in [[Deepway Ruins]] & [[Whitefury Rapids]] during [[Costume Brawl]].
* Applied to all party members after capturing the [[Center Shrine]] in [[Kysten Shore]] & [[Plikkup Works]] during [[Costume Brawl]].

==Trivia==
* This is a reference to [[wikipedia:The Princess Bride|The Princess Bride]] where the character Westley challenges Prince Humperdinck to a fight 'To the pain' rather than a fight 'To the death'.
* This spell shares its name with an [[Inscription#"To the Pain!"|inscription]].
